title: Whole Sheathed-Pseudostem Arching Banana Plant
description: One newly authored complete stylised banana-like broad-leaf herb exterior without fruit. A low stout tapered green pseudostem-like core is wrapped by two broad open-edged full sheath sheets. Five unequal whole long arching blades emerge at different heights: each includes its continuous narrow stalk root and a broad solid lamina with a thick central keel, curved section and a few deep edge clefts, not a pinnate rachis with copied narrow pinnae. A slim upright tightly rolled emerging blade rises from the centre. All plant paths, widths and surfaces newly authored, no old palm/flower mesh or coordinate arrays imported. Unlike the old tall ring-scar palm, the new plant has a short sheathed core and broad unsegmented blades; unlike the old low-crown spathe plant it has no flowering bract or spadix and no sagittate basal lobes. One static vegetation model, zero scenes. No exact species, cultivation, growth, fruit production, wind animation, botanical mechanism, root stability or edible/handling guidance. Rig animation interaction not made.
